notes: 'take not this thing to heart' swaps the Hebrew object and adjunct; the marker on לִבֵּךְ takes the adjunct's *to* (rule 16) and the לַ on דָּבָר is silenced (rule 40). The reverse allocation (לַ → *to*, marker unrepresented) was considered and is the competing reading. Margin read and set aside (rule 38).
